description: Maps ISO 14289-1 (PDF/UA-1) clauses to WCAG 2.1 success criteria
source: PDF/UA Technical Implementation Guide and WCAG 2.1

7.1.title: General
7.1.remediation_hint: Ensure the PDF is tagged with a valid structure tree. Use Adobe Acrobat Pro or accessible authoring tools.

7.2.title: Text
7.2.remediation_hint: Set document language in File > Properties > Advanced. Mark language changes with /Lang attribute on structure elements.

7.3.title: Graphics
7.3.remediation_hint: Add alternative text to all meaningful images. Mark decorative images as artifacts.

7.4.title: Headings
7.4.remediation_hint: Use proper heading tags (H1-H6) in logical order. Do not skip heading levels.

7.5.title: Tables
7.5.remediation_hint: Mark table headers with TH tags. Use scope attributes for complex tables. Avoid nested tables.

7.6.title: Lists
7.6.remediation_hint: Use L, LI, Lbl, and LBody tags for lists. Ensure list structure matches visual presentation.

7.7.title: Mathematical expressions
7.7.remediation_hint: Use MathML or provide text alternatives for mathematical expressions.

7.9.title: Notes and references
7.9.remediation_hint: Mark footnotes with Note tags. Link footnote references to their content.

7.10.title: Optional content
7.10.remediation_hint: Ensure optional content layers have a logical reading order when toggled.

7.11.title: Embedded files
7.11.remediation_hint: Provide descriptions for embedded files. Ensure embedded content is accessible.

7.12.title: Article threads
7.12.remediation_hint: Ensure article threads follow a logical reading sequence across pages.

7.13.title: Digital signatures
7.13.remediation_hint: Ensure signature fields are properly labeled and accessible.

7.14.title: Non-interactive forms
7.14.remediation_hint: Structure non-interactive forms semantically. Associate labels with values.

7.15.title: XFA
7.15.remediation_hint: Avoid XFA forms. Convert to tagged PDF with AcroForms for better accessibility.

7.16.title: Security
7.16.remediation_hint: Do not use encryption settings that block assistive technology access.

7.17.title: Navigation
7.17.remediation_hint: Add bookmarks for navigation. Ensure logical tab order. Include table of contents for long documents.

7.18.title: Annotations
7.18.remediation_hint: Provide alternative text for link annotations. Ensure annotations have meaningful labels.

7.19.title: Actions
7.19.remediation_hint: Avoid automatic actions. Provide user control over JavaScript and form submissions.

7.20.title: XObjects
7.20.remediation_hint: Ensure XObject references have proper structure and alternative text.

7.21.title: Fonts
7.21.remediation_hint: Embed fonts. Ensure character mapping (ToUnicode) is correct for copy/paste and AT.

ISO-32000-1-7.18.1.title: Link annotation alternate description
ISO-32000-1-7.18.1.remediation_hint: Add Contents or Alt entry to link annotations with meaningful link text.

ISO-32000-1-7.18.3.title: Widget annotation alternate description
ISO-32000-1-7.18.3.remediation_hint: Add TU (tooltip) entry to form widgets with descriptive labels.

ISO-32000-1-14.6.title: Marked content
ISO-32000-1-14.6.remediation_hint: Ensure all content is marked within the structure tree or as artifacts.

ISO-32000-1-14.7.title: Logical structure
ISO-32000-1-14.7.remediation_hint: Create a complete structure tree with proper parent-child relationships.

ISO-32000-1-14.7.2.title: Structure hierarchy
ISO-32000-1-14.7.2.remediation_hint: Ensure structure elements form a valid hierarchy with Document as root.

ISO-32000-1-14.8.2.2.title: Heading structure
ISO-32000-1-14.8.2.2.remediation_hint: Use H, H1-H6 tags in proper sequence. H tags must form an outline.

ISO-32000-1-14.8.4.2.title: List structure
ISO-32000-1-14.8.4.2.remediation_hint: Structure lists with L, LI, Lbl, LBody tags. Nest properly for multi-level lists.

ISO-32000-1-14.8.4.3.title: Table structure general
ISO-32000-1-14.8.4.3.remediation_hint: Use Table, TR, TH, TD tags. Ensure TH cells have scope or Headers attributes.

ISO-32000-1-14.8.4.3.5.title: Table headers
ISO-32000-1-14.8.4.3.5.remediation_hint: Mark header cells with TH. Use Scope attribute (Row/Column/Both).

01-001.title: Artifacts
01-001.remediation_hint: Mark purely decorative content as artifacts, not structure elements.

01-002.title: Content not tagged
01-002.remediation_hint: All real content must be tagged. Check for content outside structure tree.

01-003.title: Tag not mapped to role
01-003.remediation_hint: Use standard PDF tags or map custom tags to standard roles via RoleMap.

01-004.title: Circular role mapping
01-004.remediation_hint: Remove circular mappings in RoleMap dictionary.

01-005.title: Conflicting semantics
01-005.remediation_hint: Do not use tags in ways that conflict with their semantic meaning.

01-007.title: Document not tagged
01-007.remediation_hint: Set MarkInfo dictionary Marked entry to true. Create StructTreeRoot.

02-001.title: Natural language not specified
02-001.remediation_hint: Set /Lang in document catalog with valid BCP 47 language tag.

02-002.title: Language change not marked
02-002.remediation_hint: Add Lang attribute to structure elements containing different language text.

02-003.title: Invalid language tag
02-003.remediation_hint: Use valid BCP 47 / RFC 5646 language tags (e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'fr-CA').

06-001.title: Figure without alternative text
06-001.remediation_hint: Add Alt entry to Figure tags. For decorative images, use empty Alt or mark as Artifact.

06-002.title: Figure alternative text not semantically appropriate
06-002.remediation_hint: Write descriptive alt text that conveys the image meaning, not just appearance.

06-003.title: Caption relationship not established
06-003.remediation_hint: Group Figures with their Captions using a Figure parent element.

07-001.title: Document title not displayed
07-001.remediation_hint: Set ViewerPreferences/DisplayDocTitle to true. Ensure Title in document Info.

07-002.title: Document title missing
07-002.remediation_hint: Add meaningful Title to document Info dictionary.

09-001.title: Heading levels skip
09-001.remediation_hint: Use heading levels in order (H1, H2, H3...). Do not skip levels.

09-002.title: Document uses numbered headings only
09-002.remediation_hint: Avoid mixing H tags with H1-H6 tags. Use H1-H6 for explicit hierarchy.

09-003.title: First heading not H1
09-003.remediation_hint: Start document structure with H1 as the first heading.

09-004.title: More than one H1
09-004.remediation_hint: Use only one H1 per document. Use H2 for major sections.

11-001.title: Link annotation Contents key missing
11-001.remediation_hint: Add Contents entry to Link annotations with descriptive text.

11-002.title: Link annotation without link tag
11-002.remediation_hint: Wrap link annotations in Link structure element.

11-003.title: Link text empty or missing
11-003.remediation_hint: Ensure Link elements contain descriptive text content.

11-004.title: Link not linked to OBJR
11-004.remediation_hint: Associate Link structure elements with their annotation objects.

11-005.title: Reference to annotation not allowed
11-005.remediation_hint: Only Link elements may reference link annotations.

11-006.title: Link annotation alternate description
11-006.remediation_hint: Provide Alt entry for non-text link content (images, etc.).

12-001.title: Table missing headers
12-001.remediation_hint: Mark header cells with TH tag. Add Scope attribute.

12-002.title: Table headers attribute missing
12-002.remediation_hint: Add Headers attribute to TD cells referencing TH IDs in complex tables.

13-001.title: List structure invalid
13-001.remediation_hint: Lists must contain only LI children. LI must contain Lbl and/or LBody.

13-002.title: LI does not contain Lbl or LBody
13-002.remediation_hint: Each LI must have at least Lbl (label) or LBody (content).

14-001.title: Form field missing name
14-001.remediation_hint: Add TU (tooltip) entry to form field with descriptive name.

14-002.title: Form field type not supported
14-002.remediation_hint: Use standard AcroForm field types. Avoid custom field types.

14-003.title: Form field value not text
14-003.remediation_hint: Ensure form field values are accessible as text.

14-006.title: Radio button without parent group
14-006.remediation_hint: Group related radio buttons under a common parent field.

14-007.title: Checkbox without grouping
14-007.remediation_hint: Group related checkboxes semantically when they form a set.

17-001.title: Bookmarks missing for long document
17-001.remediation_hint: Add bookmarks that match heading structure for navigation.

17-002.title: Bookmark destination invalid
17-002.remediation_hint: Ensure all bookmarks point to valid destinations within the document.

17-003.title: PageLabel not defined
17-003.remediation_hint: Define page labels for consistent page numbering across viewers.

19-001.title: Content outside structure
19-001.remediation_hint: All visible content must be within the structure tree or marked as artifact.

19-002.title: Content order illogical
19-002.remediation_hint: Reorder structure elements to match logical reading sequence.

19-003.title: Tab order not defined
19-003.remediation_hint: Set Tabs entry in page dictionary to S (structure) for logical tab order.

26-001.title: Content extraction prevented
26-001.remediation_hint: Remove security settings that block content extraction for AT.

26-002.title: Printing disabled blocks accessibility
26-002.remediation_hint: Enable printing or ensure accessibility extraction is allowed separately.

28-001.title: Font not embedded
28-001.remediation_hint: Embed all fonts to ensure consistent rendering and text extraction.

28-002.title: ToUnicode CMap missing
28-002.remediation_hint: Add ToUnicode CMap to fonts for correct Unicode text extraction.

28-003.title: ActualText missing for non-Unicode glyphs
28-003.remediation_hint: Add ActualText attribute for glyphs that cannot map to Unicode.

28-004.title: Character cannot be mapped to Unicode
28-004.remediation_hint: Use fonts with proper Unicode mapping or add ActualText.
